A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GameFactory paper. The complete main text, equations, Figures 1-13, Tables 1-7 and Appendices A-C are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original quantitative experiments on action control, scene generalization, dataset effects and long-video generation in Section 6, plus collision and racing examples in Appendix B.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Tables 2-6 and the qualitative collision and racing results in Appendix B.

M1.justification: The action grouping, mouse concatenation, keyboard cross-attention, autoregressive generation and LoRA-based multi-phase training procedures are unchanged in Sections 4-5.

E1.justification: Both versions use GF-Minecraft and VPT Find Cave and retain the same open-domain, long-video, collision and racing scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 2-4 and 6 retain the same evaluated fusion variants, one-phase training baseline, VPT-trained model and loss-scope alternatives. No comparator membership changes.

E3.justification: The 5% holdout, Only-Key/Mouse-Small/Mouse-Large subsets, evaluation metrics, 1B backbone, training settings and 50-step DDIM sampling remain identical, as do Appendix A's preprocessing settings.

E4.justification: The control-mechanism, training-strategy, dataset-bias and loss-scope analyses are retained unchanged. Appendix B contains the same collision-response and racing-transfer case studies.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The uncertainty-reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and rankings in Tables 2-6 and the qualitative results match. For example, Table 3 retains multi-phase open-domain Cam 0.0997 and Flow 54.13 under the same reported settings.

T1.justification: Equation 1, the latent/action definitions and the mathematical descriptions of grouping and autoregressive generation are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation or proof is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: GF-Minecraft, keyboard/mouse action control, autoregressive generation and scene generalization through style-action decoupling.

C2.justification: The ablation interpretations, Appendix B's first-person applicability and racing-transfer discussion, Appendix C's world-model implications and the conclusion's outstanding challenges are unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 6.1 and Appendix A retain identical hardware, hyperparameters, collection/preprocessing instructions and action encoding. The documented project homepage and resource-availability statements also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Table 1 and all 53 bibliography entries retain the same cited works and research positioning. Bibliography reflow does not alter citation coverage.

P1.justification: v4 removes the Acknowledgements heading and funding paragraph naming grant 62402406 and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose and main-text/appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Removing the acknowledgement reflows the reference list across pages 9-11, alongside minor typesetting differences. Figures 1-13 and Tables 1-7 retain their content, structure, captions and placement.

improvement.justification: The complete comparison finds identical methods, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility information, including the appendices. The removed funding acknowledgement loses attribution, but this and the minor presentation changes leave overall scientific quality and readability essentially unchanged.
